August, 2024
Author: Pankaj Bhatia

Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:55728
Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 8704 of 2024
Applicant :- Suraj

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home U.P. Lko.
Counsel for Applicant :- Harish Pandey,Sagun Chandra Rastogi

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
None has appeared for respondent no.2 despite notice.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.39 of 2024, under Section 363, 366, 376, 506 IPC & Section 5/6 of POCSO Act, P.S. Sammanpur, District Ambedkar Nagar.
3. The FIR in question was lodged as a missing person report.
Subsequently, in the statements under Section 161 & 164 Cr.P.C. the victim did not support the prosecution story and stated that the applicant and the victim have married.
The victim has even refused to undergo medical examination.
The tentative age of the victim is around 17 to 18 years.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Considering the two statements, the applicant who is in custody since 15.06.2024 and has no criminal history, is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Suraj be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
